pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal regions with smooth pixel gradients at the boundaries. Spatial area is significantly larger on the upper flank, becoming smaller and more fragmented toward the posterior and lower extremities.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of light-toned interstitial space. Junction nodes are primarily tri-point intersections. The pathways maintain a consistent pixel thickness and topological continuity across the visible torso.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane creates a low-amplitude serrated silhouette along the dorsal line of the neck and shoulder. Frequency of serrations is high but individual hair-level detail is constrained by pixel resolution.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: A localized, sub-circular region of hyper-pigmentation is visible on the upper mid-flank, exhibiting a darker tonal value than the surrounding patches and disrupting the local tessellation pattern.
